subject: Post-call: Stakeholder map + decision criteria (latency / cost / deployment)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@brightpathhealth.com>, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:30:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call: Stakeholder map + decision criteria (latency / cost / deployment)

Samantha — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and concrete asks so we keep momentum.

TL;DR: BrightPath wants a low-latency user experience for clinician-facing summarization and a cost-efficient batch pipeline for analytics. Next step: confirm the buying process and the economic buyer, plus concrete targets for latency and cost.

Key points from our call:
- Primary use cases: real-time visit note summary (on call with clinician) and nightly batch embeddings for analytics.
- Expected Q4 pilot: ~100 clinicians, ~3k real-time requests/day, average request size ~600 tokens; nightly analytics run over ~2M records.
- Constraints: PHI sensitivity, must support VPC/private deployment or strong managed encryption; SOC 2 evidence required.

Asks / next steps:
1) Stakeholder map: can you confirm who owns the economic decision, who will sign contracts (procurement/legal), and who owns security/compliance? Please include names and best emails.
2) Decision criteria: from a product perspective — what are the numeric targets we should optimize to (latency p95 target in ms for the real-time flow; cost-per-1k-requests or monthly budget for pilot)?
3) Deployment preference: do you need Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) for pilot, or would Dedicated/reserved capacity in our hosted environment be acceptable provided desk-level controls and KMS?
4) Timeline: target pilot start and contract lead time.

Attachments: Redwood_Technical_Overview.pdf (high-level runtime and deployment options). I attached a blank mutual action plan template; happy to fill once you share stakeholders.

I'll loop Marcus on the technical follow-ups and Lauren on commercial/contracting. Thanks again — if you prefer a short follow-up call to map stakeholders I can set 20 minutes this week.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@brightpathhealth.com, legal@brightpathhealth.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 17:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: Stakeholder map + decision criteria (latency / cost / deployment)

Ben — great to talk, and thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers inline below and attaching our security questionnaire for reference (BrightPath_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx).

Stakeholders:
- Economic buyer / budget owner: Rachel Park, VP of Operations (rachel.park@brightpathhealth.com) — signs off on pilot budget.
- Procurement contact: procurement@brightpathhealth.com (cc'd) — handles PO and contract intake.
- Legal: legal@brightpathhealth.com (cc'd) — will do initial T&Cs and data processing addendum.
- Security/compliance lead: Marcus Chen, InfoSec (marcus.chen@brightpathhealth.com) — will want SOC 2 + network architecture.

Decision criteria (product/ops):
- Real-time latency target: p95 <= 350 ms end-to-end (clinician-facing). If that's not feasible, please propose tradeoffs.
- Cost guidance: pilot budget cap is $12k/month (all-in) — we'd like an estimate for both hosted and private options.
- Deployment: preference is VPC-private or Dedicated in our region for PHI; we'll evaluate hosted if KMS + strict network egress controls are possible.
- SLA expectations: 99.9% uptime for pilot is ideal; need RTO/RPO for incident scenarios.

Timeline: aiming to start pilot mid-September. Procurement expects a 4–6 week review once contract is received.

Happy for you to loop Rachel and Marcus Chen. Let's plan a short call with procurement if you need to walk through contract formats.

— Samantha
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Clinical Ops | BrightPath Health
Samantha.ortiz@brightpathhealth.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@brightpathhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, procurement@brightpathhealth.com, legal@brightpathhealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:11:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: Stakeholder map + decision criteria (latency / cost / deployment)

Thanks Samantha — helpful clarity. Two quick items from commercial side:

1) Pricing anchor: Ben, can you prepare a short pricing sketch (hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) that maps to the $12k/mo pilot cap and the volumes Samantha outlined? Include expected token-based costs and any fixed reserved capacity fees so Rachel has a clear comparison.

2) Contract path: procurement looped in — typical Redwood pilot MSA + SOW; procurement, does BrightPath accept a standard PO + master services agreement, or do you require fully executed DocuSign for the pilot? If there are standard templates you prefer, please share.

3) Technical follow-up: Marcus (InfoSec) — Marcus Lin (cc'd) from our security integrations team will schedule a short architectural review to show network flows, KMS support, and SOC 2 artifacts. Marcus Lin, can you propose 30 minutes this week or next?

I'll draft a mutual action plan once pricing and dates are available; Ben, if you can get that sketch and a proposed pilot SOW by EOD Thu (23 Jul), we'll aim to have a procurement-ready packet to Rachel the week after.

— Lauren

Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
